verdicts.reason: A3 fails: the brief names 'no second concept' and says second concepts leak, but counting one 'Concept:' line does not catch a second concept named or previewed inside the Example or body text.

A3 fails: the done-when never checks that the answer was marked (no mark line or count), and cmp exit 1 is met by any one-byte or wording change, so 'change the example, not the paragraph' is not enforced.

All rules hold: a 1/1 line count of 'gap:'/'next:' with no further step list is program-readable, assisted matches the brief, 'gap: none found'/'gap: unsupported' pass as results, and checkRunnable false is honest.
A3 fails: a single skill tag throughout catches a second skill but not a next level or new item set after the marks, so 'do not move on inside the same directive' is only partly enforced.

All rules hold: human-only check with status gated (never reliable), the done-when enforces 'propose, a person sets it' via status: proposed and no model-written order, and checkRunnable false is honest.
